clauses.english: First Party (Employer): Al Noor Facilities Management Co., CR No. 1010458823, Riyadh.
Second Party (Employee): Mr. Joel Santos, Philippine national, Passport No. P4471882B.
1. Position: Cleaner at client sites in Riyadh.
3. Working hours: 10 hours per day, 6 days per week. Overtime is paid at the normal hourly rate.
4. Fees: The cost of the residence permit (Iqama), work permit and its renewal shall be deducted from the Employee's salary.
5. Documents: The Employee's passport shall remain with the Employer for safekeeping during the contract.
6. Leave: The Employee is entitled to 15 days of annual leave after two years of service.
7. Termination: If the Employee resigns before the end of the contract, he shall pay the Employer SAR 8,000 as compensation for recruitment costs.
